items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Shared hooks for Rad UI FX: reduced-motion detection (OS setting or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce"), run-once-in-view, and offscreen pausing.

accessibility: Honours both the OS Reduce motion setting and an in-app data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" ancestor.

items.name: blur-reveal
items.title: BlurReveal
items.description: Text that fades in from a soft blur, word by word or letter by letter. Screen readers get the whole sentence once; reduced motion shows it instantly.

accessibility: The full text is rendered once in a visually hidden span; the animated pieces are aria-hidden. Do not remove either.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce shows the text immediately, with no blur, movement or stagger.
Use the `as` prop to keep the correct heading level instead of wrapping in another heading.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types text out character by character with a caret. Screen readers get the full text immediately and nothing reflows while typing.

accessibility: The full text is in a visually hidden span; the typed copy and caret are aria-hidden.
An invisible copy of the final text reserves its size, so surrounding layout never shifts.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the full text at once with a still caret.
The caret stops blinking shortly after typing finishes.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: ScrambleText
items.description: Text that decodes from random characters into its final form, on view, on hover, or on mount.

accessibility: Screen readers only ever get the final text (visually hidden); the scrambling copy is aria-hidden.
Server render shows the final text, so content is readable before hydration.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) skips scrambling entirely.

items.name: shimmer-text
items.title: ShimmerText
items.description: A soft highlight sweeping across real, unsplit text.

accessibility: Text is never split, so screen readers, selection and translation work normally.
The base colour is currentColor: check its contrast; the highlight only brightens it briefly.
Forced-colours mode falls back to plain text.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops the sweep.

items.name: color-shift-text
items.title: ColorShiftText
items.description: Text filled with a slowly flowing multi-colour gradient.

accessibility: Text is never split.
Every colour in the gradient must meet contrast against the background, since any of them can sit under any letter.
Forced-colours mode falls back to plain text.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) freezes the gradient.

items.name: word-cycle
items.title: WordCycle
items.description: An inline slot that cycles through words, sized to the longest so the sentence never jumps.

accessibility: Screen readers hear every word once as a list ("fast, accessible or yours"), never a changing word.
Cycling pauses on hover and offscreen; pass `paused` from a visible control if it sits next to reading content (WCAG 2.2.2).
With `colors`, every word colour must meet contrast against the background, since each one is shown on its own.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the first word, still.

items.name: count-to
items.title: CountTo
items.description: A number that counts up to its value when it scrolls into view, formatted with Intl.NumberFormat.

accessibility: Screen readers get the final formatted value only; the ticking copy is aria-hidden.
Tabular figures prevent sideways jitter.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the final value without counting.

items.name: wave-text
items.title: WaveText
items.description: Letters that ripple in a travelling wave, continuously or on hover.

accessibility: The full text is read once from a visually hidden copy; the rippling letters are aria-hidden.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it, and `trigger="hover"` only moves under the pointer.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the letters still.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: GlitchText
items.description: Text that breaks into offset colour slices in short, occasional bursts.

accessibility: Bursts are brief and spaced seconds apart, staying well under 3 flashes per second (WCAG 2.3.1).
The colour layers are real aria-hidden elements, not ::before content that some screen readers announce; the text is read once.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) removes the glitch entirely.

items.name: marker-highlight
items.title: MarkerHighlight
items.description: A highlighter stroke that sweeps behind words as they scroll into view.

accessibility: Renders a real <mark> by default, so assistive tech knows the text is highlighted; use as="span" for decoration only.
Text keeps its own colour; pick a marker colour that keeps contrast with it.
Wrapped highlights get one stroke per line.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the full highlight immediately.

items.name: ink-underline
items.title: InkUnderline
items.description: A hand-drawn squiggle that draws itself under a word, on view or on hover.

accessibility: The squiggle is an aria-hidden SVG; the words are untouched.
`trigger="hover"` also draws on keyboard focus inside, so links get the same affordance.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the underline already drawn.

items.name: split-flap
items.title: SplitFlap
items.description: Departure-board tiles that flip through characters before landing on the text.

accessibility: Screen readers get the text once, as written; the tiles are aria-hidden.
Server render shows the final text, so it is readable before hydration.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the final tiles with no flipping.

items.name: morph-words
items.title: MorphWords
items.description: Words that melt into one another with a gooey liquid morph.

accessibility: Screen readers hear every word once as a list, never a changing word.
The gooey filter only runs mid-morph, so resting text stays crisp.
Pauses on hover and offscreen; `paused` stops it from a visible control (WCAG 2.2.2).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) swaps words without blur or filter.

items.name: spotlight-text
items.title: SpotlightText
items.description: A pool of coloured light that follows the pointer across text.

accessibility: The real text always shows at its own colour and contrast; the light is an aria-hidden copy on top.
Pointer-driven only: nothing moves on its own.
Forced-colours mode drops the light.

items.name: extruded-text
items.title: ExtrudedText
items.description: Chunky 3D extruded lettering that tilts toward the pointer.

accessibility: Real, unsplit text; the depth is text-shadow.
Tilt is capped and off for touch input.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the depth but disables the tilt.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: CircularText
items.description: Text running around a slowly turning circle, with an optional centre icon.

accessibility: The ring is an aria-hidden SVG; the text is read once, trimmed.
Pauses on hover and offscreen; `paused` stops it.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops the rotation.

items.name: neon-text
items.title: NeonText
items.description: A glowing neon sign with a rare, gentle flicker.

accessibility: Real, unsplit text.
The flicker is two short dips every 7 seconds, far below 3 flashes per second; turn it off with `flicker={false}`.
Use it on a dark surface and check contrast of the pale letters, not the glow.
Forced-colours mode drops the glow.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the glow steady.

items.name: aurora-backdrop
items.title: AuroraBackdrop
items.description: Soft drifting colour glow behind any content. Decorative only, pauses offscreen, and stays still under reduced motion.

accessibility: The glow layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce keeps the colours but stops the drift.
The drift pauses automatically offscreen. If it runs behind content for long, give users a visible pause control wired to the `paused` prop (WCAG 2.2.2).
Check text contrast over the brightest part of the glow.

items.name: grid-backdrop
items.title: GridBackdrop
items.description: A perspective grid gliding toward the viewer and fading at the horizon.

accessibility: The grid is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) holds the grid still.

items.name: dot-field
items.title: DotField
items.description: A dim dot grid with a soft pool of light drifting across it.

accessibility: Both dot layers are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) parks the light in the centre.

items.name: starfield
items.title: Starfield
items.description: A field of softly twinkling stars, generated from a seed so server and client match.

accessibility: Stars are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the stars, without twinkling.

items.name: meteor-shower
items.title: MeteorShower
items.description: Occasional streaks of light falling across the background.

accessibility: Meteors are aria-hidden and ignore pointer events.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) removes the meteors rather than freezing them mid-flight.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: GlowCard
items.description: A card whose surface lights up under the pointer, and around keyboard focus.

accessibility: The glow layer is aria-hidden; the card adds no roles or tab stops of its own.
Focus inside the card lights it too, so keyboard users get the same affordance.
Check text contrast with the glow at full strength.

items.name: perspective-card
items.title: PerspectiveCard
items.description: A card that tilts gently toward the pointer, with an optional glare.

accessibility: Tilt is capped (8° by default) to avoid vestibular discomfort.
Touch input never tilts, so scrolling past the card on mobile stays still.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) disables the tilt.
The glare is aria-hidden.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Pulls a button or link a little toward the pointer.

accessibility: Wraps the child in a span instead of cloning it, so the child keeps its role, props, ref and focus.
Keyboard focus and activation are unaffected.
Touch input never moves it.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) disables the pull.

items.name: click-burst
items.title: ClickBurst
items.description: A small burst of sparks from wherever a button is clicked.

accessibility: Sparks are aria-hidden, ignore pointer events and are removed after their animation.
Keyboard activation bursts from the centre of the element.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows no sparks.

items.name: reveal-on-scroll
items.title: RevealOnScroll
items.description: Content that fades and slides into place as it scrolls into view.

accessibility: Content is always in the DOM and the accessibility tree; only its opacity and position animate.
Keyboard focus landing inside hidden content reveals it immediately.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows content from the first paint.

items.name: orbit-border
items.title: OrbitBorder
items.description: A comet of light running around an element's border.

accessibility: The light is a pseudo-element: nothing is added to the accessibility tree.
Browsers without @property show a still highlight.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows a still highlight.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A seamless, infinitely scrolling row of items: logos, testimonials, tags.

accessibility: Items are exposed once; the looping copy is aria-hidden and inert, so nothing is read or focused twice.
Pauses on hover and whenever focus is inside; `paused` stops it from a visible control (WCAG 2.2.2).
Pass `label` to expose it as a named region.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops scrolling and wraps the items into a normal row.

items.name: sliding-tabs
items.title: SlidingTabs
items.description: Rad UI Tabs with an indicator that slides between triggers and content that fades in.

accessibility: Built on Rad UI Tabs: tablist/tab/tabpanel roles, arrow-key navigation and focus management come from the library.
The indicator is aria-hidden decoration.
Focus-visible outline is kept on triggers.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) snaps the indicator and skips the fade.

items.name: noise-grain
items.title: NoiseGrain
items.description: A film-grain overlay that gives flat surfaces texture, optionally shimmering.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Keep `opacity` low and re-check text contrast with the grain on.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) freezes the grain.

items.name: wave-lines
items.title: WaveLines
items.description: Layered waves drifting along the bottom edge, back waves slower for depth.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) holds the waves still.

items.name: light-beams
items.title: LightBeams
items.description: Stage lights shining down from the top edge, gently swaying.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) parks each beam at its resting angle.

items.name: bubble-field
items.title: BubbleField
items.description: Soft bubbles rising and drifting, seeded so server and client match.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) scatters the bubbles at rest.

items.name: pulse-rings
items.title: PulseRings
items.description: Rings radiating out from a centre: live status, radar, "on air".

accessibility: Rings are aria-hidden; give the centre content its own accessible name if it means something (e.g. "Live").
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows one still ring.

items.name: shine
items.title: Shine
items.description: A band of light that sweeps across a button or card on hover and keyboard focus.

accessibility: Wraps the child without cloning it, so its role, props and focus are untouched.
Keyboard focus inside triggers the same sweep as hover.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) removes the sweep.

items.name: press-ripple
items.title: PressRipple
items.description: A ripple that spreads from exactly where a button is pressed.

accessibility: Ripples are aria-hidden and removed after their animation.
Enter and Space ripple from the centre, so keyboard presses get feedback too.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows no ripple.

items.name: confetti-burst
items.title: ConfettiBurst
items.description: A burst of confetti from wherever a button is clicked.

accessibility: Confetti is aria-hidden, ignores pointer events and is removed after about a second.
Keyboard activation bursts from the centre.
Pair it with a real status message for what happened; confetti alone says nothing to a screen reader.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows no confetti.

items.name: pointer-parallax
items.title: PointerParallax
items.description: Layers that drift with the pointer at different depths.

accessibility: Purely visual: layout, reading order and focus order never change.
Touch input never moves the layers.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps every layer still.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: FlipCard
items.description: A card that turns over in 3D to reveal its back.

accessibility: Flipping is an explicit button, never hover-only, so it works with keyboard, touch and screen readers.
The hidden face is inert and aria-hidden: Tab and screen readers only reach the side you can see.
The button label says what it will do ("Show back"), so it is not also marked aria-pressed.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) cross-fades instead of turning.

items.name: stagger-list
items.title: StaggerList
items.description: List items that fade up one after another as the list scrolls into view.

accessibility: List semantics, order and content are untouched; only opacity and position animate.
Focus moving into the list reveals every item at once.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the list from the first paint.

items.name: draw-checkbox
items.title: DrawCheckbox
items.description: A native checkbox whose tick draws itself in.

accessibility: A real <input type="checkbox">: forms, labels, keyboard and screen readers work exactly as usual.
Visible focus ring on the drawn box.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) switches state without drawing.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: Numbers that roll digit by digit like a mechanical counter.

accessibility: Screen readers get the formatted number as plain text; the rolling strips are aria-hidden.
`live` opts in to polite announcements of changes; leave it off for numbers that change often.
Defaults to en-US formatting so server and client match.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) swaps digits without rolling.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A toolbar of icon buttons that swell as the pointer passes over them.

accessibility: role="toolbar" with one Tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move between items.
Every button has an accessible name; the floating label is visual only.
The focused item magnifies, so keyboard users see where they are.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) disables magnification.

items.name: toggle-switch
items.title: ToggleSwitch
items.description: An on/off switch whose knob squishes on press and springs across.

accessibility: A button with role="switch" and aria-checked, labelled by its visible label.
Space and Enter toggle it; visible focus ring.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) moves the knob without the spring.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: CardStack
items.description: A deck of cards you page through, the front card flying to the back.

accessibility: Only the front card is reachable: the others are inert and aria-hidden.
Previous and Next are real buttons; the position ("Card 2 of 5") is announced politely.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) swaps cards without the fly-out.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: ProgressRing
items.description: A circular progress indicator, determinate or spinning.

accessibility: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, or no value while indeterminate; requires a `label`.
The percentage text is aria-hidden because the value is already exposed.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) turns the spinner into a gentle pulse, so "busy" still reads.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder with a soft shimmer.

accessibility: One role="status" message ("Loading") instead of a pile of empty boxes; the shapes are aria-hidden.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the placeholder still.

items.name: typing-indicator
items.title: TypingIndicator
items.description: Three bouncing dots for "someone is typing".

accessibility: role="status" with a label such as "Ada is typing"; the dots are aria-hidden.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) replaces the bounce with a slow fade.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: A small loader in three styles: dots, bars or orbit.

accessibility: role="status" with a label; the art is aria-hidden.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) turns every style into a slow pulse, so "busy" still reads.

items.name: wipe-reveal
items.title: WipeReveal
items.description: An editorial wipe: a colour bar sweeps across and leaves the text behind it.

accessibility: Real, unsplit text that stays in the accessibility tree; only its clip animates.
The bar is aria-hidden.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the text with no wipe.

items.name: letter-drop
items.title: LetterDrop
items.description: Letters that fall in from above and land with a small bounce.

accessibility: The text is read once from a visually hidden copy; the falling letters are aria-hidden.
Words never break mid-word while animating.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the text in place.

items.name: strike-swap
items.title: StrikeSwap
items.description: A word gets struck out and its replacement springs in.

accessibility: Uses real <del> and <ins>, so assistive tech can tell which word was removed and which replaced it.
The struck word stays readable; the new word is not conveyed by colour alone.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the final strike and word without motion.

items.name: fill-text
items.title: FillText
items.description: Outlined letters that flood with colour, in view or on hover.

accessibility: Real, unsplit text.
Outline-only text is hard to read, so it fills as soon as it is visible by default.
Forced-colours mode shows plain text.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the text already filled.

items.name: lava-lamp
items.title: LavaLamp
items.description: Wax-like blobs that rise, sink and merge behind content.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) holds the blobs still at different heights.

items.name: fireflies
items.title: Fireflies
items.description: Little lights wandering on their own paths and glowing on and off.

accessibility: The effect layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events; only children are exposed.
The glow fades gently; there is no flashing.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) keeps the lights still and steady.

items.name: crt-overlay
items.title: CrtOverlay
items.description: Scanlines, a slow rolling band and a vignette over any content.

accessibility: The overlay is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
Deliberately no flicker: flashing overlays are a seizure risk.
Keep `intensity` modest and re-check text contrast under the scanlines.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) removes the rolling band.

items.name: halo-glow
items.title: HaloGlow
items.description: A slowly turning, blurred colour halo behind a logo, avatar or button.

accessibility: The halo is aria-hidden; the content inside is untouched.
Pauses offscreen; `paused` stops it on demand.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) stops the rotation.

items.name: flashlight
items.title: Flashlight
items.description: Hovering darkens everything except a beam that follows the pointer.

accessibility: Fully lit by default and whenever keyboard focus is inside, so nothing is hidden from people not using a mouse.
The darkness is an aria-hidden overlay; content and focus order are untouched.
Forced-colours mode drops the overlay.

items.name: expand-strip
items.title: ExpandStrip
items.description: A row of panels where the one under the pointer or focus widens to show more.

accessibility: A labelled list; each panel is a link or focusable region, and focus expands it just like hover.
Titles and descriptions are always in the DOM, so screen readers get everything.
A scrim keeps white text readable on any background.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) expands instantly.

items.name: compare-slider
items.title: CompareSlider
items.description: A before/after comparison with a draggable divider.

accessibility: Driven by a real <input type="range">: arrow keys, Home/End, touch and value announcements come from the browser.
Visible focus ring on the handle.
Give both images meaningful alt text in `before` and `after`.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: CopyButton
items.description: A copy button whose icon morphs into a check.

accessibility: The result is announced with a role="status" "Copied" message, not just shown.
Needs an accessible name via `label`, e.g. "Copy install command".
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) swaps the icons without animating.

items.name: expand-search
items.title: ExpandSearch
items.description: A search button that widens into a field.

accessibility: A role="search" form; the toggle reports aria-expanded and controls the field.
Focus moves into the field when it opens; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.
The field is out of the Tab order while closed.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) opens instantly.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Progress steps whose connecting line fills as you advance.

accessibility: An ordered list with aria-current="step" on the current step.
Completed steps say "(completed)" in text, not just with a tick.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) changes state without animating.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: NotificationBell
items.description: A bell that rings and pops its badge when the unread count goes up.

accessibility: The count is in the button's accessible name ("Notifications, 3 unread"), read on focus without live interruptions.
The badge number is aria-hidden to avoid reading it twice.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) updates the badge without ringing.

items.name: smooth-details
items.title: SmoothDetails
items.description: A native <details> disclosure with an animated height.

accessibility: Native <details>/<summary>: keyboard, screen readers, find-in-page and no-JS all work.
Animates where ::details-content is supported; elsewhere it opens instantly.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) opens without animation.

items.name: toast-stack
items.title: ToastStack
items.description: Stacked toast notifications that fan out on hover or focus.

accessibility: A labelled region with a polite live list: new toasts are announced without stealing focus.
Every toast has a labelled dismiss button; focusing the stack fans all toasts out so each is reachable.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows toasts without sliding.

items.name: success-check
items.title: SuccessCheck
items.description: A ring and tick that draw themselves, then pop.

accessibility: role="status" with a `label`, so the success is announced when it appears.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) shows the finished tick.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: ProgressBar
items.description: A progress bar with a moving sheen, determinate or indeterminate.

accessibility: role="progressbar" labelled by its visible label, with aria-valuenow (omitted while indeterminate).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (or data-rad-fx-motion="reduce" on an ancestor) drops the sheen; an indeterminate bar pulses in place instead of sliding.

items.name: strength-meter
items.title: StrengthMeter
items.description: Four bars that fill and change colour with strength, e.g. for passwords.

accessibility: role="meter" with aria-valuetext ("Strong"), not just a number.
The level is written out in text, so colour is never the only signal.
